provenance.initialization: Real new_game; ordinary competition adoption; existing budget allocations/departments renewed through dated native commands
provenance.retention: Two final native archives plus two sandbox archives for full-horizon cells; resumed/saves/monthly.json plus its native backup are bounded scratch; failing worlds retained when serializable

scope: Native paired stability cell only; no S25 or CP1 certification
